identity_and_archetype.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Cinematic, Exclusive, Velvet & Wine, Champagne Gold)
identity_and_archetype.emotional_tone: High-end, intimate, sensual, prestigious, velvet night club & private member lounge aesthetic
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine high-end concierge aesthetic, Swiss grid precision, and dark velvet warm gradients.
Restrained Opulence: Gold and magenta are surgical triggers for CTA and status, never flat ocean gradients.
Tactile Depth: Multi-layered radial velvet auroras, 1px champagne hairlines, and optical glassmorphism (backdrop-saturate + blur).
No Pure Black or Pure Whites: Tint all dark backgrounds with deep burgundy/violet undertones (#0D0B12, #140F1A) and body text with warm alabaster (#F8FAFC, #F1EFEE).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, inputs, cards, dropdowns, tabs) include `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case).
Replace all default drop-down selects with Shadcn styled select/dropdown-menu to prevent raw browser popovers.

Implement the provided logo image URL (https://customer-assets-cm19k8pv.emergentagent.net/job_gifts-meet/artifacts/ufi6kx23_ChatGPT%20Image%20Sep%2012%2C%202026%2C%2007_48_52%20PM.png) inside header nav logo, auth card header, and mobile bar.
Maintain the dark velvet background #0D0B12 with champagne gold borders (#D4AF37) and rose crimson (#E11D48) accents.
Use `.font-serif-luxe` (Cormorant Garamond) for primary headings to deliver an editorial luxury magazine feel.
Apply `.glass-strong` or `.glass` backdrops with explicit border colors to prevent content overlapping background bleed.
